# exemplar subject

The entity whose pattern the exemplar evidences — a frame-scoped character whose conduct across the cited work is the example (EPIC #358: 823 such links in the foundation corpus), an organization, a person. Range intentionally open. NOT functional, optional: span-pinned exemplars need no subject, and subject + selector may coexist (the span shows one instance of the pattern; the subject names its bearer). At least one of viaSelector / exemplarSubject (SHACL).

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/exemplarSubject>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:exemplarSubject`  

**Type:** `owl:ObjectProperty`  

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/norms>
